description: This file defines the Gdpr class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling GDPR-related email notifications for user data requests and deletions. It includes methods for sending GDPR request emails and processing GDPR data removal notifications.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR email notifications and data removal processes within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending GDPR request emails based on provided arguments, constructing email content, and queuing email tasks.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Processes GDPR data removal notifications, constructs and queues GDPR deletion emails based on user data and store information.
